data.intro: This is a travel log containing my experiences around the world.

recommendedApps.name: Google Maps
recommendedApps.purpose: Global navigation, saved places, transit routes, and offline maps.
recommendedApps.notes: Essential baseline navigation app almost everywhere.

recommendedApps.name: Organic Maps
recommendedApps.purpose: Offline maps with walking trails and remote-area coverage.
recommendedApps.notes: Very useful where mobile signal is unreliable.

recommendedApps.name: Rome2Rio
recommendedApps.purpose: Compare routes between cities using flights, trains, buses, ferries, and cars.
recommendedApps.notes: Best for early-stage route planning.

recommendedApps.name: Omio
recommendedApps.purpose: Book trains, buses, and flights across multiple regions.
recommendedApps.notes: Especially strong in Europe and North America.

recommendedApps.name: Skyscanner
recommendedApps.purpose: Compare global flight prices across airlines.
recommendedApps.notes: Good for flexible-date searches.

recommendedApps.name: Google Flights
recommendedApps.purpose: Search flights, compare prices, and track fare changes.
recommendedApps.notes: Great for exploring cheap destinations from a starting airport.

recommendedApps.name: AirWander
recommendedApps.purpose: Find multi-city flights and stopover ideas.
recommendedApps.notes: Useful for turning layovers into extra destinations.

recommendedApps.name: Booking.com
recommendedApps.purpose: Book hotels, hostels, and apartments worldwide.
recommendedApps.notes: Strong global coverage.

recommendedApps.name: Airbnb
recommendedApps.purpose: Short-term apartment rentals and unique stays.
recommendedApps.notes: Useful for longer stays.

recommendedApps.name: Hostelworld
recommendedApps.purpose: Find and book hostels around the world.
recommendedApps.notes: Best for backpacking, solo travel, and meeting other travellers.

recommendedApps.name: FlixBus
recommendedApps.purpose: Book affordable long-distance bus routes.
recommendedApps.notes: Very useful in Europe and some other regions.

recommendedApps.name: Uber
recommendedApps.purpose: Ride-hailing across multiple continents.
recommendedApps.notes: Availability varies by country.

recommendedApps.name: Google Translate
recommendedApps.purpose: Translate text, speech, and images between languages.
recommendedApps.notes: Offline language packs available.

recommendedApps.name: Wise
recommendedApps.purpose: International payments and multi-currency account management.
recommendedApps.notes: Useful for transfers, travel spending, and better exchange rates.

recommendedApps.name: Revolut
recommendedApps.purpose: Multi-currency spending, budgeting, and travel card payments.
recommendedApps.notes: Good backup card and useful for tracking travel expenses.

recommendedApps.name: WieBetaaltWat
recommendedApps.purpose: Split costs with friends during trips.
recommendedApps.notes: Useful for group travel, shared accommodation, food, fuel, and activities.

recommendedApps.name: GetYourGuide
recommendedApps.purpose: Book tours, attractions, day trips, and experiences.
recommendedApps.notes: Good for organized activities in popular destinations.

recommendedApps.name: Klook
recommendedApps.purpose: Book activities, transport passes, attractions, and experiences.
recommendedApps.notes: Especially useful in Asia, but available in many global destinations.

recommendedApps.name: TripAdvisor
recommendedApps.purpose: Find reviews for attractions, restaurants, hotels, and tours.
recommendedApps.notes: Useful for checking whether places are worth visiting.

recommendedApps.name: Worldpackers
recommendedApps.purpose: Find volunteer and work-exchange opportunities while travelling.
recommendedApps.notes: Useful for longer, cheaper, and more social travel.

recommendedApps.name: Workaway
recommendedApps.purpose: Find cultural exchange, volunteering, and work-stay opportunities.
recommendedApps.notes: Good for slow travel and staying longer in one place.

recommendedApps.name: Survival Manual
recommendedApps.purpose: Offline emergency and survival reference.
recommendedApps.notes: Helpful in remote areas.

wishlist.name: Portugal
wishlist.notes: Visit Portugal and explore its cities, coastline, food, and culture.

wishlist.name: Full Balkans roadtrip
wishlist.notes: Do a full roadtrip around the Balkans.

wishlist.name: Caves underneath Budapest
wishlist.notes: Explore the cave systems underneath Budapest.

wishlist.name: Sweden east coast to Nordkapp and Norway west coast roadtrip
wishlist.notes: Roadtrip up the east coast of Sweden to the Nordkapp, then travel down the west coast of Norway.
